decision_signals.baseline_under_test: Treat the FY2028 growth outlook as unconstrained demand.
decision_signals.new_evidence: Management raised FY2028 revenue growth outlook from approximately 70% to 75%; its answer invokes both demand and additional supply.
decision_signals.mechanism: Revenue realization depends on eligible supply, customer funding and accepted systems; the analyst's 100% premise was not reaffirmed.
decision_signals.affected_decision: Keep unconstrained demand and deliverable capacity as separate scenarios; require a supply-to-acceptance bridge before increasing deployment commitments.
decision_signals.confidence: High on the mirrored statement; forecast realization unverified.
decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: Allocated components fail to convert into qualified, funded and accepted systems, or management revises its fiscal growth outlook.

decision_signals.baseline_under_test: Carry the Q3 margin into Q4 or treat the guided trough as a permanent competitive floor.
decision_signals.new_evidence: Q4 guided gross margin 71–72%; prepared remarks give FY2028 72–73%. Arcuri's answer discusses absorbing supply costs on existing orders and moving to new pricing.
decision_signals.mechanism: Purchase-order vintage and price realization can delay cost recovery; the call does not quantify price, mix or cost contributions.
decision_signals.affected_decision: Model existing-order and new-order economics separately; keep FY2028 margin recovery conditional.
decision_signals.confidence: High on fiscal-period wording; medium on mechanism and low on undisclosed quantitative attribution.
decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: New-price realization or component-cost evidence fails to support the guided fiscal margin recovery.

decision_signals.baseline_under_test: A purchase order or reserved component capacity is enough to establish deployable output.
decision_signals.new_evidence: Buchalter's answer identifies site readiness, capital and credible offtake as allocation criteria.
decision_signals.mechanism: Delivery eligibility requires several conditions at once; financing or energization can bind despite available silicon.
decision_signals.affected_decision: Gate reservations and deployment dates on funded, powered sites and acceptance evidence.
decision_signals.confidence: High on stated criteria; actual customer-level allocation unverified.
decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: Observed allocation proceeds without these stated gates, or funded ready sites remain constrained by upstream qualified output.

decision_signals.baseline_under_test: New disclosure wording proves a new financing policy or eliminates all guarantee exposure on delays.
decision_signals.new_evidence: Rasgon receives a management no-change explanation. Written CFO disclosure separately records 32bn contingent neocloud agreements and 118bn maximum guarantees.
decision_signals.mechanism: Instrument-specific activation and expiry determine exposure. Pre-activation conditionality does not establish cancellation of all guarantees or remove post-activation risk.
decision_signals.affected_decision: Retain separate exposure schedules and wait for contract-level/filing evidence before reducing modeled support risk.
decision_signals.confidence: High on category separation; instrument-level enforceability remains unreviewed.
decision_signals.next_falsifying_observation: The actual Q3 10-Q or underlying contract terms disclose revised triggers, amounts, expiry or activated obligations.
